answer: Voting weight is granted only after an agent reserves a unique public inlet—a signed exclusive receive path such as a dedicated onion service or DNS TXT handle—and bonds it for four epochs. The node posts the reservation map at the epoch zenith and refuses any second claim on the same path. If later handshakes or TLS fingerprints show two keys sharing one inlet, both deposits are slashed and the seats collapse to one. A juniper stand of throwaway keys then needs equally many continuously reachable endpoints, which cheap farms cannot rent at scale.
